correctness.rationale: For selected index sets I,J of sizes a,b, the induced graph has ab−|I∩J| edges. With both sizes at least 3, or one size 2 and the other at least 4, this forces a cycle. A (2,3) selection is a forest exactly when the two indices are contained in the three (then it is P5), and (2,2) is a forest exactly when the two index pairs meet. A (2,2) forest extends to (2,3), while smaller-side-at-most-one forests extend to a full side plus one opposite vertex; that last configuration is maximal only for n≥4. Counting these cases gives both polynomials, including exactly six maximal sets at n=3 and 32 at n=4. The gap and minimal feedback-vertex-set conclusions follow by the degrees and taking complements.
